items.title: Breece Hall: Works on side Monday

items.title: Jonathon Brooks: Possible committee with Hubbard's return
items.description:
Coach Dave Canales told reporters Monday that the Panthers will go with a committee in Week 1 with Brooks and Chuba Hubbard (hamstring), provided that Hubbard is healthy, per Joe Person of the Athletic.
